# Doom Pi Hook

Compiled TypeScript modules and Claude-compatible command hooks for DoomPi sessions.

## How to author

- [Author DoomPi hooks](./src/prompts/doompi-author-hook/SKILL.md): Create `.doom/hooks.yaml` groups, compiled TypeScript modules, and Claude-compatible command hooks.

## Package reference

- [Package README](./README.md): The hook registry, group selection, event mapping, decisions, and failure handling.
